prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical Instagram cover image
Primary request: A photorealistic Japanese kyotei motorboat-racing scene on a wide lake course, with soft mountains on the horizon, an overcast sky, and a gentle swell.
Scene/backdrop: broad open lake, subdued distant mountains, cloudy dark sky, natural water texture.
Subject: two or three authentic Japanese kyotei racing boats in a close pack exiting a turn. Every boat is a single-seat racing boat about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to its racer, with a light white or pale-grey hull. Each has an OPEN cockpit with absolutely no canopy, roof, or windshield bubble. Each racer crouches or kneels very low, leaning forward, both hands on a small steering wheel, wearing a plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; no face visible. Exactly one outboard motor on each stern, with a large white spray plume behind it.
Style/medium: highly realistic sports photography, authentic proportions and mechanics, natural atmospheric detail.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5. Place the boats entirely in the lower half. Keep the top 45 percent dark, uncluttered negative space for a later title overlay. Dynamic turn-exit motion while preserving clear boat anatomy.
Lighting/mood: cool, dramatic overcast daylight, restrained contrast.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: no recognizable real person; all boats must follow the same authentic kyotei construction; faces fully hidden.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, brand marks, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, banners, typographic shapes, offshore powerboats, F1 tunnel boats, enclosed cockpits, canopies, roofs, windshield bubbles, extra motors.

verification.method: visual inspection of the generated image
verification.notes: Visually inspected at full image view. The image shows three low, long, light-colored, open-cockpit kyotei racing boats traveling in a close pack on a wide lake beneath an overcast sky, with soft mountains on the horizon. Each racer is crouched low in a plain full-face helmet and plain suit with the face hidden. One stern outboard motor and a large white spray plume are visible for each boat. The boats remain in the lower half, while the upper 45% is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, or recognizable real person are visible.
